shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/dod.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; rg -n "inputSchema|ToolRegistry|tool input|validate.*tool" specs .specify src/orchestration/tools src/types/ai.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/tools/index.ts; sed -n '1,160p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.test.ts; sed -n '1,250p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '200,245p' .specify/spec.md; rg -n \"jest|testMatch|spec anchor|specs/\" jest.config.js eslint.config.* .lore"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" src scripts specs | head -60; sed -n '1,130p' src/types/ai.ts; cat jest.config.js; git status --short --branch; git remote -v"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,90p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md; sed -n '1,80p' specs/hal-engine-spec-link-placement/spec.md; sed -n '1,100p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs; rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts; rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor\\.mjs"'$'"' || true; git diff --check; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add tool input validation acceptance test" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
